s.note: Hallorann's tour of the giant pantry
s.how: Lay out crackers, a big jar of dill pickles, a bowl of olives and a drained tin of peaches on a board like the hotel storeroom. Add a 250g wedge of cheddar for good measure.

s.note: the room nobody should go into
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo and 1 tsp Dijon. Pipe back into the whites and finish with smoked paprika and chives. Don't go in there.

m.note: snowed in for the winter with a full kitchen
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg chuck roast hard. Soften 2 onions, 3 carrots and 2 celery sticks, add 250ml red wine and 500ml stock, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Add 800g potatoes for the last hour.

w.note: he asks Danny if he likes chocolate ice cream
w.how: Warm 400ml cream and 300ml milk with 150g dark chocolate and 2 tbsp cocoa. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook, stirring, to 82C. Chill overnight and churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.

d.note: Jack's order from Lloyd at the Gold Room
d.how: Put a large block of ice in each of four heavy tumblers. Pour 60ml bourbon over each. Sip slowly at the bar, and don't trust the bartender.
